title: Command
description: The normalised entry into the one execution path. A chat message, a CLI invocation, a schedule and a webhook all produce this object. No command exists without an authenticated identity; replies go back to the channel it came from. See docs/architecture/control-plane.md.

channel.description: The channel capability the command arrived through: channel.chat, channel.cli, channel.web, channel.repo, channel.time, channel.event. A capability, never a product name.

identity.description: The single authenticated Taktus identity of the sender. An opaque identifier, not a name or an address.

org_path.description: Where the sender acts: tenant, then department or group, team, project. Drives visibility, sharing and cost attribution.

recognised.description: The intent Taktus recognised, as a lowercase dotted token. Absent until recognised.

context.description: Channel context: issue, thread, file, previous run. Shape depends on the channel.
